description: Select the slides that best fit the current presentation request. Respect each slide inclusion policy, placement metadata, and every slide-selection group rule.

efficio_slide_role.purpose: Identifies a slide as normal content or a section divider. Use it only as descriptive context; it does not control inclusion, placement, ordering, or grouping.

efficio_slide_placement.purpose: Indicates where the slide must sit in the deck so selection preserves required opening and closing slides.

enum_descriptions.fixed_start: A pinned opening slide that stays at the front of the deck in group order.
enum_descriptions.body: A flexible content slide selected and ordered by relevance.
enum_descriptions.fixed_end: A pinned closing slide that stays at the back of the deck in group order.

efficio_slide_inclusion_policy.purpose: States how strongly the slide should be included so selection honors required and excluded slides.

enum_descriptions.always: Always include this slide regardless of the request.
enum_descriptions.default_include: Include this slide unless there is a clear reason not to.
enum_descriptions.when_relevant: Include this slide only when it is relevant to the request.
enum_descriptions.default_exclude: Exclude this slide unless there is a clear reason to include it.

selection_group_instructions.purpose: Selection groups constrain which slides may be returned together. Return only selected_slides; do not return group decisions or group metadata.

type_descriptions.choice: An active choice group selects exactly one direct member. An optional root choice may select no members.
type_descriptions.bundle: An active bundle group selects every direct member recursively. An inactive bundle selects none of them.

inclusion_policy_descriptions.always: Always include this slide regardless of the request.
inclusion_policy_descriptions.default_include: Include this slide unless there is a clear reason not to.
inclusion_policy_descriptions.when_relevant: Include this slide only when it is relevant to the request.
inclusion_policy_descriptions.default_exclude: Exclude this slide unless there is a clear reason to include it.

rules: Only root groups carry inclusion_policy; nested groups are activated by their parent.
Group members are direct slide_id or group_id references.
A valid final selection must satisfy every active choice and bundle recursively.
A normalized single-slide root is treated as a standalone slide rather than a group.
